g.text: Structural exploration — fixed 8-input subset / 32 non-Tag candidates
DH_P0 / candidate cycles (>1: faster than DH_P0)
GM uses only the SAME accepted input intersection across all four columns; missing cells never become zero.
Arrows use exact integer-cycle comparisons; a rounded 1.000 may still be ↑ or ↓. Color clips outside 0.25–4.
16 Tag-safety HOLD plan cells were not simulated and are excluded from this grid, not counted as performance negatives.
Costs: pool labels are 128B-line slot accounting, not verified payload/PPA. Tag512 and 850MHz downstream remain fixed.
PIB192 also raises create-Q; Tag2×4 grants do not imply 8 data ports. CH/DH are not equal area or timing.
